Hi Priya / Daniel,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good discussion and a lot of alignment on the problem you’re trying to solve (reducing inference cost for real-time personalization while keeping latency sub-100ms). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Key takeaways:
- Primary goal: replace slow on-prem model path for 3ms serving tier — target 80–100ms p95 for user-facing features.
- Data constraints: PII-stripped event stream, retention policy 90 days, GDPR region requirement for EU customers.
- Success metric for pilot: 50% cost reduction on per-token inference and p95 latency <=100ms at 10 RPS.

Proposed next steps (to unblock pilot):
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO intro) — 20–30m to confirm runway, security posture, and success criteria.
2) Technical deep-dive / infra runbook — 60–90m with your engineering + our SE to map integration and gating items.
3) Mutual Action Plan — I attached a draft MAP (editable) with owners and dates; happy to iterate.

Availability we can offer for the VP/CTO intro (short call):
- Tue May 10 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed May 11 — 16:00–16:30 PT

For the technical deep-dive (90m preferred):
- Thu May 13 — 09:00–10:30 PT
- Fri May 14 — 13:00–14:30 PT

If those don't work, please send two windows that suit Daniel's CTO and Priya's calendar. I’ve CC'd Marissa (AE) and Karthik (SE) so we can lock a slot quickly.

Attachments: Storix_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx), Discovery-Notes-Storix-20270504.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I’ll hold the proposed windows for 24 hours.
